title: Metrics: precision, recall, faithfulness and relevance

videos.script: Precision and recall mean the same arithmetic about two different things: what a search returned, and what a detector flagged. {{two}} Take the judge from the last lessons as a detector of the replies people failed, and move its threshold. {{sweep}} Up to the middle it flags the same fifteen, four of them bad. Higher, it flags good replies and catches nothing more. At the top it flags everything. {{trade}} There is no trade to make, because its scores do not rank the replies. Check that first. Which threshold is right comes after, and depends on what the flag drives. {{which}} Then five metrics for the two releases. Correctness falls, and context recall says two of the lost answers never reached the model. {{flat}} The other four the model had in hand, and refused. Context recall reached the model, not the customer. {{floor}} And a name is not a definition. Each framework means something different by relevance. {{names}}
